Before / After
Before is GitHub develop at 31d29db45, the base perf/nov was rebased onto. After is the branch perf/nov-v2 at 790ea168f. Both run on copies of the same backup.
Rebase conflict
A file both perf/nov and develop changed after 11 Nov. The walk checks that develop's feature there still works and that perf/nov's change is in.
Live refresh
A screen that updates by itself when someone changes a record elsewhere, with no reload. The server sends a list_update message over the socket.
Another tab / another user
The walk makes a change in a second browser (the same user logged in again) or through the Administrator, and watches the first one.
list_update
Frappe's socket message that a record of a doctype was added, saved or deleted. A screen listens to it by joining that doctype's room.
useListUpdate
This branch's hook that runs a screen's code on each list_update of one doctype. Its users: the sidebar notifications, the reminders panel, the users list.
useDocTypeEventListener (#1670)
Develop's safe listener. Its room count keeps a doctype's room joined while any screen still listens, so closing one screen cannot cut off another.
Badge
The number beside Notifications in the sidebar: unread notifications among the newest 500.
Raised By Me › Rejected
A view of Project Payments for the person who raised the payment. Develop added its 'Open PO' / 'Open WO' link on 12 Nov.
Cheque chip
The small 'Cheque <no> · <status>' label on a cheque payment. For cheque roles it is a button that opens the Cheque; for others it is plain text.
CHEQUE_ACCESS_PROFILES
The roles that may open a Cheque: Admin, Accountant, Accountant Lead and the procurement roles. A PMO Executive views cheques but cannot open them.
Vendor › Payments sub-tabs
Paid, Cheque Pending and Other Pending Payments on a vendor's page (develop, 20 Nov).
Action Center
The right-hand panel of a dashboard. Its Reminders list shows compliance tasks (TDS, GST filings) that are due.
Release PO list
The Purchase Orders page's tabs Approved PO ... All POs (release-po-select).
owner_name / raised_by_name
The name of the person who made a record, sent with each row by the server, so the screen need not download the whole users list.
PO Wise
The old Payments list of every PO and WO (project-payments-list). No button leads to it any more; the walk reaches it by typed URL only to measure it.
Typed URL
A page opened by typing its address. It is setup for a measurement, not proof that a user can reach the screen.
Not walked
A claim no screen can show. The walk names the test that pins it, or says that none does.
Must / Should / Nit / Note
How serious a pinned point is: must fix before merge, should fix, small polish, or just worth knowing.
